messages.author: 056a0f54645c6009
messages.subject: How can I add percentiles?
parts:
Hi all,

The built in descriptive stats include a 25% and 75% along with SD mean,
min, max etc.

How can I add a 10% and 90% class as well?

Bruce

messages.author: 30dc0c001c553eb0
messages.subject: Re: How can I add percentiles?
parts:
Hi Bruce

One option would be to use the Custom Button below Run descriptives and enter you own function

e.g. Function Name: Custom Percentiles
function(x) quantile(x, c(0.10,0.90), na.rm=TRUE)

You can add as many quantiles as you like to the list.

Best
Rudolf
